These are test-only copies of three existing exercise posters from the app's
exercise catalog, retrieved on 2026-10-28. Production continues to use the
catalog's Cloudflare image URLs. The fixtures let visual tests render real
exercise previews without a network connection.

- dumbbell-bench-press.jpg: Dumbbell Bench Press
- dumbbell-fly.jpg: Dumbbell Fly
- dumbbell-shoulder-press.jpg: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press

Their source is the existing male exercise image collection in the
pub-2111ee02db9e4d4396611479b3804ef3 Cloudflare R2 bucket, under
images/library-v2-0ec4cff4d082/. The app catalog's media rights and attribution
continue to apply.
